subject.title: Feature: Pre-compaction agent notification, structured handoff window, and deferral mechanism

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-controlled pre-compaction lifecycle contract for warnings and structured handoff, and may that contract include bounded agent-requested deferral?
rationale: Current main has partial building blocks, but the requested behavior adds new public config and a security-sensitive authority boundary at compaction time that automation should not invent.

options.title: Adopt warning and checkpointed handoff first
options.body: Add a single lifecycle surface for pre-threshold warning and structured handoff while deferring agent-requested compaction delays until the authority model is designed.

options.title: Adopt full bounded deferral
options.body: Permit agents to request short compaction deferrals, but only with max duration, audit trail, workspace/action matching, approval expiry, and policy-version checks in the first implementation.

options.title: Decline new lifecycle surface
options.body: Keep memoryFlush, notifyUser, hooks, and existing checkpoints as the supported compaction tools and close this tracker in favor of narrower documentation or plugin work.

recommendation.title: Adopt warning and checkpointed handoff first
recommendation.body: Add a single lifecycle surface for pre-threshold warning and structured handoff while deferring agent-requested compaction delays until the authority model is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the memoryFlush feature history and the Codex compaction boundary, both of which show strong recent history for steipete.
